title: DNA pairs A–T and G–C; RNA uses U for T
caption: The two DNA strands are complementary: A pairs with T by two hydrogen bonds, G with C by three. An RNA copy of the coding strand has the same sequence but with uracil in place of thymine.
alt: The coding strand of a short gene, its complementary template strand, and the matching mRNA, with the bases coloured by type.
description: Template strand, base-paired to it: TACCACGTGGAC (A–T, G–C).
mRNA copy: AUGGUGCACCUG, the coding strand with U for T.
31 hydrogen bonds hold this stretch of the double helix together: 2 for each of 5 A–T pairs and 3 for each of 7 G–C pairs.
